pins: pi and the recommended versions are in test/ci/package.json

recommended.name: pi-subagents
recommended.why: Background workers and reviewers; the kit's agents run on it. 0.84.0 fixes GHSA-6v8j-6w28-2w8r (workflow-script sandbox escape in 0.41.0-0.83.x).

recommended.name: pi-ask-user
recommended.why: Structured questions to the user (choices, free text). Local only, no dependencies.

recommended.name: @ff-labs/pi-fff
recommended.why: Fast fuzzy file and content search (ffgrep, fffind). Local only; prebuilt native binary.

recommended.name: @juicesharp/rpiv-todo
recommended.why: Live todo list (tool todo, /todos) kept in session entries, so it survives compaction. Local only.

optional.name: pi-web-access
optional.why: Web search and fetch. Sends queries to third parties (Exa by default), runs git/gh/ffmpeg/yt-dlp, and fetch_content also reads local paths outside the guardrails.

optional.name: pi-mcp-adapter
optional.why: Lazy-started MCP servers (e.g. a docs server such as Context7). Replaces pi's built-in MCP; MCP calls bypass the guardrails.

optional.name: pi-intercom
optional.why: Messages between pi sessions; cooperates with pi-subagents. Spawns a local broker; dependencies have install scripts.

optional.name: pi-autoresearch
optional.why: Experiment loop for experts. Its log_experiment runs git checkout -- . and git clean -fd, and run_experiment runs bash outside the guardrails.

optional.name: @plannotator/pi-extension
optional.why: Plan mode with a browser review UI. 52 MB, node-pty install script, local server (0.0.0.0 over SSH), contacts GitHub and other services.

skills.name: mattpocock/skills
skills.why: Optional. Well-used engineering skills (MIT); load only skills/engineering to skip deprecated and in-progress ones.

skills.name: badlogic/pi-skills
skills.why: Optional. CLI-tool skills from pi's author (search, browser tools, transcription); several need API keys or Google OAuth.

excluded.name: pi-claude-bridge
excluded.why: Registers Claude Code as a model provider: changes model routing and auth and bridges to another vendor.

excluded.name: pi-cursor-sdk
excluded.why: Provider backed by Cursor's agents: bridges to another vendor.

excluded.name: @injaneity/pi-computer-use
excluded.why: Drives desktop apps and a browser (computer use); postinstall native helper.

excluded.name: pi-background-tasks
excluded.why: Overrides the built-in bash and overlaps the kit's background shell tools.

excluded.name: @gotgenes/pi-permission-system, cc-safety-net
excluded.why: Overlap the kit's guardrails; two gates on the same calls are confusing.
